method: Enumerate y,z in [0,31] and t with t²≤279. Recover x=t²−3y−5z and retain exactly x in [0,31]. Sort distinct triple skeletons lexicographically. Retain the independent w range and square table. Build joint(n,t), n and t coefficient profiles by one pass through each skeleton/w pair; no explicit quadruple-row table.
reader: Inclusive x,y,z,w,n,t conditions by scanning saved skeletons and binary-searching the saved square table. Saved weighted blocks support tuple lex rank/select; optional conditional target image is fresh reader work, with full caches and work retained.
staging: Native public source/input/plan checkpoint before once-only constructor; complete output checkpoint before reader; exact reader plan and per-call output/caches; full frozen spec checkpoint before publisher.
serialization: ASCII JSON, optional lossless contiguous text shards ≤300000 code units with ordered full identity if artifacts exceed 2MiB.
exclusions: No global conjecture, novelty, prize eligibility or current-status claim
